description: This file defines the interface and functions for integrating hiredis with libevent, including event handling, updating, attaching, and cleanup routines.

classes.name: redisLibeventEvents
classes.description: Structure holding event-related data for redis and libevent integration.

methods.name: redisLibeventHandler
methods.description: Handles libevent events, calling appropriate redis async handlers based on event type.

methods.name: redisLibeventUpdate
methods.description: Updates the event flags and reassigns the event in libevent.

methods.name: redisLibeventCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and frees event resources.

methods.name: redisLibeventSetTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for the event.

methods.name: redisLibeventAttach
methods.description: Attaches redisAsyncContext to a libevent event base.
